xform_meta.name: whiten
xform_meta.variant: stabilized centered PCA whitening (not ZCA, and not a reproduction of any published whitening recipe)
xform_meta.caveat: whitening changes the loss weighting across directions; in a whitened space the top eigenvalues are nearly tied, so 'its PC1' is unstable and its own-space FVU is a diagnostic only
